note: Sixth screening, whole games to their end (day limit 300) against Nullkiller2 on fresh maps: six maps each of Skirmish M and Balance M of pool fresh1, both seats, 384 games. Base: the defaults of 20.11. It asks whether what screening 5 and the screening of the opening pointed to holds on other maps. A = artifactCare (+0.08 +- 0.11 in screening 5, one artifact more worn on day 70, main army +27,500 +- 20,400 on day 84) and Q = skillChoice + primaryByArmy (+0.05 +- 0.07): the hero itself. K = kitePlan + latePlan 1 (+0.06 +- 0.10). X = two scouts (opening, 768 games to day 42: +0.18 +- 0.08 towns, +6.4 points of the map seen, +2.3 guard fights, army not smaller) and Y = supplyRuns 1 (+0.13 +- 0.09 towns, +0.5 hero levels). U = surrender 2: a lost battle is bought free instead of fled from (requirement S20 of the user, 22.11.). D = tour once more (+0.03 +- 0.07). F = fightForecast 1 with plans - level 1, which lost 29 instead of 42 games in screening 4 on the twelve known maps, while level 2 cost games on Blockbuster and Long Run (-0.11 +- 0.10): which of the two findings holds on fresh maps. Design: eight switches or groups of switches on the base {}, 2^(8-4) resolution IV, shared pool; A = artifactCare 1; Q = skillChoice 1 + primaryByArmy 1; K = kitePlan 1 + latePlan 1; X = scouts 2; Y = supplyRuns 1; U = surrender 2; D = tour 1; F = fightForecast 1 + forecastPlans 1.
